title: The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.02191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated striking capabilities on frontier mathematical problems, it remains unclear whether they possess the structural mathematical understanding underlying their solutions. In this paper, we take a first step toward systematically studying mathematical understanding in LLMs, from diagnosing its distinct capabilities to leveraging these findings to improve post-training. First, we introduce the notion of Mathematical Primitive to probe structural mathematical understanding and propose \hlei{}, a novel benchmark that evaluates mathematical reasoning along four distinct dimensions: Discovery, Generation, Digestion, and Execution. Second, our systematic diagnosis shows that solution accuracy masks distinct capability profiles, primitives unlock substantial latent execution capacity, and Discovery is the dominant bottleneck in mathematical reasoning. translated_title: 缺失的原语：诊断并修复大型语言模型中的数学推理
translated_abstract: 虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）在前沿数学问题上展现出了惊人的能力，但它们是否具备支撑其解题过程的结构化数学理解仍不清楚。本文迈出了系统性研究LLM数学理解的第一步，从诊断其独特能力到利用这些发现改进后训练。首先，我们引入“数学原语”（Mathematical Primitive）的概念来探测结构化数学理解，并提出一个新的基准，从四个不同维度评估数学推理：发现、生成、消化和执行。其次，我们的系统性诊断表明，解题准确率掩盖了各不相同的能力画像，原语能够解锁大量潜在的执行能力，而“发现”是数学推理中的主要瓶颈。我们的后训练分析进一步表明……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“数学原语”概念及一个从发现、生成、消化、执行四个维度评估LLM数学理解的新基准，发现解题准确率掩盖了模型真实的能力差异且“发现”能力是数学推理的主要瓶颈，并可据此指导后训练的改进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Mathematical Primitives" and a novel benchmark evaluating LLM mathematical reasoning across four dimensions—Discovery, Generation, Digestion, and Execution—showing that solution accuracy masks distinct capability profiles and that Discovery is the dominant bottleneck, which can guide post-training improvements.
